# Assignment 2: I2C Sensors

## Objective

When an incident happens in an industrial setting, it is important to keep a log of data to analyse the cause of the incident.
Here, we want to mimic such a scenario.

* The temperature sensor shold read temperature each second.
* The last 15 measurements need to be stored in memory.
* When the temperature exceeds the threshold, the LED turns on and the log is printed on the terminal.
* You may decide what happens after this event - this is not specified.

If you are not sure how to use arrays in C or Python, feel free to search for the relevant information online.

## Requirements
* The detection of excess temperature and LED action need to be triggered by the sensor interrupt pin
* Your record must be stored in an array of 15 elements, at most. Do not allocate a very large array and only print the last 15.
